intelligence.human_view: The formatting IS the service. A page that dumps all its content at once makes the person do the machine's work — scroll, squint, find where they are, read a squished wall of text. A Smart Block does that work for them: one screen, perfectly formed to what they're seeing, and the next one a click away. The name matters because the team needs one word for the unit — when every seat says "Smart Block" they mean the same thing: a screen that fits perfect, presents beautifully, and looks real, high tech, premium. And "presentation is everything" is the standard that judges it: not what the page says, how it says it — the ten-star delivery of intelligence.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a book where every page is just right — big and beautiful, and you press a button and the next page pops right up, perfect! Every page is its own little show, and it looks like magic.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, imagine a lovely book, dear, where every page fits just right, dear — you press a button and the next page comes right up, perfect, dear. Every page its own little show, dear, and it looks so beautiful, dear, like the finest thing, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: EVERY SCREEN IS A SMART BLOCK. PERFECTLY FORMATTED. REAL. HIGH TECH. PREMIUM. LIKE A NAYA.
